steps.name: qa-blocks
steps.eval: (() => { const S=/[\u200B\u200C\u200D\uFEFF\u2060-\u2063\u{1D173}-\u{1D17A}]{4,}/u; const hit=v=>!!v&&S.test(v); return { blocks: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-sanity]')].map(e=>decodeURIComponent(e.getAttribute('data-sanity'))).filter(v=>/path=pageBuilder:qa-[a-z-]+-1(;|$)/.test(v)).map(v=>v.match(/path=([^;]+)/)[1]), mainText: document.querySelector('main')?.innerText.length } })()

steps.name: B6
steps.eval: (() => { const S=/[\u200B\u200C\u200D\uFEFF\u2060-\u2063\u{1D173}-\u{1D17A}]{4,}/u; const hit=v=>!!v&&S.test(v); const imgs=[...document.querySelectorAll('img[alt]')]; const as=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')]; return { imgAlt: imgs.length, altHits: imgs.filter(i=>hit(i.getAttribute('alt'))).length, aHref: as.length, hrefHits: as.filter(a=>hit(a.getAttribute('href'))).length } })()

steps.name: D5
steps.eval: (() => { const S=/[\u200B\u200C\u200D\uFEFF\u2060-\u2063\u{1D173}-\u{1D17A}]{4,}/u; const hit=v=>!!v&&S.test(v); const sec=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-sanity]')].find(e=>decodeURIComponent(e.getAttribute('data-sanity')).includes('qa-image-with-video-1')); const fr=[...(sec?.querySelectorAll('iframe[title]')??[])]; const btn=[...(sec?.querySelectorAll('[aria-label]')??[])]; return { found: !!sec, iframes: fr.map(f=>({title: f.getAttribute('title')?.slice(0,60), hit: hit(f.getAttribute('title'))})), ariaLabels: btn.map(b=>({tag:b.tagName, label: b.getAttribute('aria-label')?.slice(0,60), hit: hit(b.getAttribute('aria-label'))})) } })()

steps.name: I3-qa

steps.name: K1
steps.eval: (() => { const S=/[\u200B\u200C\u200D\uFEFF\u2060-\u2063\u{1D173}-\u{1D17A}]{4,}/u; const hit=v=>!!v&&S.test(v); const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>/Dodaj do koszyka/i.test(b.innerText)); return { buttons: b.map(x=>({disabled: x.disabled, aria: x.getAttribute('aria-disabled'), text: x.innerText.trim().slice(0,40)})), note: document.body.innerText.includes('Zakup niedostępny w podglądzie') } })()

steps.name: I2-before

steps.name: K2
steps.eval: (() => { const S=/[\u200B\u200C\u200D\uFEFF\u2060-\u2063\u{1D173}-\u{1D17A}]{4,}/u; const hit=v=>!!v&&S.test(v); const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button[aria-label]')].filter(x=>/koszyk/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label'))); return { count: b.length, disabled: b.filter(x=>x.disabled||x.getAttribute('aria-disabled')==='true').length, labelHits: b.filter(x=>hit(x.getAttribute('aria-label'))).length, sample: b.slice(0,2).map(x=>x.getAttribute('aria-label')) } })()
